schedule.title: Daily schedule
schedule.description: Manage daily appointments, status updates, clinical visit notes, and private WhatsApp reminders.

patients.title: Patients
patients.description: Review patient records, critical medical alerts highlighted in red, and private clinical attachments.

treatments.title: Treatments catalog
